method: Two different publishers' page bodies directly read for every prepared entry. No copied source prose, lyrics, screenshots or video assets. Source statements summarized in original wording. Original videos and game scenes not watched directly; primary earliest posts not verified. This is source-backed editorial drafting, not human accuracy validation or recommendation-use approval.

duplicate_check.basis: PR37 pilot-state entries including titles and aliases read during this task; requested titles absent. Integration also screened pending writes.
